transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. Before I sign it, I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule changes, readiness changes, or required administrative controls. Specifically, I need to confirm: are all six assigned training trucks released and available for the driver-certification block, and are we keeping it in the normal Tuesday morning slot? Also, any issues with the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel? Let's hear from the S-3 first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a schedule change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. This tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, which is why it wasn't visible during prep. This will need to be reflected on the sustainment-training board before you sign it today.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a readiness change regarding the driver-certification block. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The remaining two trucks will not be released until Friday at 0800, and this inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. Those two trucks must remain on hold until their inspections are complete. This means we will only have four trucks available for Tuesday morning's driver-certification block, not the standard six.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.driver_certification_window: Tuesday morning, with only four of six assigned training trucks available; two trucks remain on hold until Friday 0800

commitments.detail: Add the Wednesday 1300-1500 radio-procedures refresher for 2nd Platoon to the sustainment-training board before publication.
Annotate on the training board that only four of six assigned training trucks are released and available for Tuesday morning's driver-certification block; two trucks on hold until Friday 0800.
Ensure the attendance roster for the 2nd Platoon radio-procedures refresher is submitted after Wednesday's training.
Sign and publish the updated sustainment-training board NLT 1600 today reflecting both the schedule change and readiness change.
